pr_title: Refuse an old Node before installing

comments.comment: supported compares version strings by hand, which the repository's standards forbid.
comments.failureScenario: supported in scripts/node-range.mjs compares the running Node with the engines range through two patterns and a numeric comparison. AGENTS.md says "Compare versions and version ranges with the `semver` package. Never compare version strings by hand." The file states why semver cannot be asked before install, and the standard states no exception for that. A contributor relying on the rule expects every version comparison to go through semver, and this one does not.
